# Plagiarism.org

> Plagiarism.org is an educational resource dedicated to promoting academic integrity through comprehensive guides on plagiarism detection, prevention, and institutional policy frameworks.

The site provides evidence-based content for students and educators, including definitions of plagiarism under U.S. law, practical prevention strategies, citation guidance, and research-backed benchmarking data on academic misconduct policies across UK universities.

## Key Topics

- Academic Misconduct
- Academic Integrity
- Plagiarism Prevention
- Citation Guides
- Plagiarism Penalties
- Plagiarism Definition
- Student Discipline
- Higher Education
- Intellectual Property
- Creative Commons
- Copyright Laws
- UK Universities
- Writing Integrity
- Source Evaluation
- Academic Standards

## Core Educational Resources

- [Home | Plagiarism.org](https://www.plagiarism.org): Homepage introducing Plagiarism.org's mission to support academic integrity education
- [What is Plagiarism](https://www.plagiarism.org/article/what-is-plagiarism): Comprehensive guide defining plagiarism under U.S. law and copyright standards
- [Preventing Plagiarism When Writing](https://www.plagiarism.org/article/preventing-plagiarism-when-writing): Practical guide to plagiarism prevention with citation and note-taking tips
- [Plagiarism Facts and Statistics](https://www.plagiarism.org/article/plagiarism-facts-and-stats): Research-backed statistics on academic misconduct from leading institutions

## Institutional Plagiarism Policy & Research

- [Plagiarism Reference Tariff](https://www.plagiarism.org/paper/plagiarism-reference-tariff): Points-based tariff system for plagiarism penalties in UK institutions
- [Benchmark Plagiarism Tariff](https://www.plagiarism.org/paper/benchmark-plagiarism-tariff): Benchmark tariff framework for institutional plagiarism penalties
- [Academic Misconduct Benchmarking Research Project: Part 1](https://www.plagiarism.org/paper/academic-misconduct-benchmarking-research-project-part-1): Research paper on academic misconduct benchmarking in UK universities
- [Academic Misconduct Benchmarking Research Project: Part 2](https://www.plagiarism.org/paper/academic-misconduct-benchmarking-research-project-part-2): Second research paper on misconduct penalties and expulsion policies

## Student Guides & Best Practices

- [Why is it Still Plagiarism When I Paraphrase and Use My Own Words?](https://www.plagiarism.org/blog/why-is-it-still-plagiarism-when-i-paraphrase-and-use-my-own-words): Explains paraphrasing plagiarism and APA citation requirements for students
- [4 Tips to Easily Avoid Plagiarism](https://www.plagiarism.org/blog/4-tips-to-easily-avoid-plagiarism): Tips for avoiding plagiarism using Google Scholar and credible sources
- [What Is Creative Commons Anyway?](https://www.plagiarism.org/blog/what-is-creative-commons-anyway): Guide to Creative Commons licensing and attribution for content sharing

## Video Training & Educator Resources

- [Coaching Conversations](https://www.plagiarism.org/video/coaching-conversations): Video training on plagiarism prevention and citation guidance for educators
- [Student Online Research and Critical Thinking](https://www.plagiarism.org/video/student-online-research-and-critical): Video on student research, source evaluation, and critical thinking skills
- [Everything is a Remix](https://www.plagiarism.org/video/everything-is-a-remix): Keynote video on remix culture and creativity in intellectual property context
